Josh O’Connor Responds to James Bond Casting Speculation

03 Nov 2026, 10:54 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: www.hollywoodreporter.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysActor Josh O’Connor has addressed recent reports regarding potential casting for the next James Bond film. Reports have linked O’Connor, known for his roles in The Crown, Knives Out, and Challengers, to the iconic MI6 role following Daniel Craig's departure.

In this article
  1. Addressing the Rumors
  2. Context and Production Details

Addressing the Rumors

Actor Josh O’Connor has addressed recent reports regarding potential casting for the next James Bond film. Reports have linked O’Connor, known for his roles in *The Crown*, *Knives Out*, and *Challengers*, to the iconic MI6 role following Daniel Craig's departure.

While speaking at the opening of a new Everyman Theatre in his hometown of Cheltenham, England, O’Connor described the speculation as an "incredibly bizarre pinch me moment." He acknowledged that being considered in that bracket is extraordinary, but maintained that there was nothing further to report.

Context and Production Details

Reports indicate that casting discussions and screen tests for the Amazon MGM Studios project are reportedly underway. The film is associated with director Denis Villeneuve and writer Steven Knight, though official studio announcements regarding the final casting remain pending.

Other actors frequently mentioned in connection with the role include Callum Turner and Jack Lowden. Casting director Nina Gold, who previously worked with both Lowden and O’Connor, is reportedly leading the talent search.

Industry Reactions

Former James Bond actor Pierce Brosnan also weighed in on the ongoing speculation during a recent interview with *Vanity Fair*. Brosnan expressed admiration for the actors being discussed, specifically noting his former co-star Callum Turner.

  • Key Takeaways:
  • Josh O’Connor acknowledged the Bond rumors as flattering but offered no confirmation.
  • Reports suggest casting efforts are being led by Nina Gold.
  • Former Bond star Pierce Brosnan publicly praised contender Callum Turner.

Verification of the official cast will require direct announcements from Amazon MGM Studios or authorized production representatives.
